title: Object-bound intentions and cross-domain federation
summary: Layered Audio exposes intentions from the live Audio object graph. AudioRecording, AudioElement, AudioView and compound selections remain native objects; Intention Service interprets and READY-gates them, while Management Intention Discovery federates domain surfaces and follows Audio-owned relationships without becoming Audio or Storage authority.
invariants: Audio intention discovery is dynamic and side-effect-free; every discovery reads current Audio truth.
Intention candidates retain the actual Audio objects. IDs, paths and prose are evidence or join keys, never substitutes for the selected domain objects.
Multiple plausible selectable objects remain CLARIFY; the provider must not guess.
A compound Audio selection is itself an intention-capable object and is revalidated against current recording, view and element relationships.
Intention Service owns interpretation, clarification and READY gating; it does not own Audio semantics or mutate Audio evidence.
Management Intention Discovery owns federation and bounded traversal; it consumes Audio-owned relevance and relationships instead of copying Audio vocabulary.
Audio may publish relationships from recording to element or view, derived element to parent, view to source element, and element to an Audio-Storage binding.
Storage identity reached through an Audio binding remains Storage authority. Audio never turns a path, locator or materialisation lease into canonical Audio identity.
Related Storage intention surfaces are supplied by Storage and may be discovered through Management; they are not globally manufactured or reimplemented by Audio.
Installation uses Management's public source, relationship, related-discovery and explorer contracts. Audio wiring does not acquire lifecycle authority over Management directories.
A view or element that disappears from the live recording disappears from the next advertised Audio surface.
procedure: Create the AudioIntentionProvider over the live recording and context.
Expose object-bound Audio surfaces for the recording and current child objects.
Build ManagementRelatedSurfaceDiscovery with AudioManagementRelatedIntentionSourceProvider when related authorities such as Storage are available.
Resolve and explore against fresh discovery; preserve exact object references in evidence and selections.
At dispatch, revalidate current Audio truth and refuse stale or newly ambiguous selections.
